steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and lightly grease a 23 x 33 cm baking dish with olive oil.
Cook the rice in 360 ml of water in a small saucepan for 15 minutes, until water is absorbed; set aside.
Peel and finely dice the onion; mince the garlic cloves.
Slice the tops off the bell peppers and remove seeds and membranes; set the peppers upright in the baking dish.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; add the onion and garlic and cook 3 minutes.
Add the lean ground beef; cook for 5 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Stir in the tomato paste, ground cumin, sweet paprika, and salt; cook 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and cooked rice; stir to combine and remove from heat.
Spoon the beef and rice filling evenly into the four bell peppers, pressing gently.
Bake uncovered for 25 minutes, until the peppers are tender. Serves 4 family portions; refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days.
